instructions:
Each item is an ontology term that a column of sample metadata in a gene
expression study can mean. Write up to 5 aliases for each term: other ways a
researcher would write that same variable as a column header in sample
metadata.

Good aliases:
- common abbreviations and acronyms ("sbp" for systolic blood pressure)
- shorter everyday phrasings ("systolic bp", "visual acuity")
- the plain name of the quantity when the term's label is wordy
  ("intraocular pressure" for "intraocular pressure measurement")

Rules:
- An alias must mean the same variable as the term: not a broader or narrower
  one, and not a related one.
- No values ("male", "high"), units on their own, gene or tool names, or
  dataset-specific codes.
- No alias that only rewords the label trivially (plural, case,
  punctuation). Those are matched already.
- Fewer is better than wrong. If a term has no natural alias, return an empty
  list.

Examples:
- systolic blood pressure -> ["sbp", "systolic bp", "systolic pressure"]
- intraocular pressure measurement -> ["intraocular pressure", "iop"]
- visual acuity measurement -> ["visual acuity", "va"]

items.label: single cell library information
items.definition: Information about a single cell sequencing library.

items.label: end bias
items.definition: The end of the nucleic acid molecule that is preferentially sequenced (bias in read distribution).

items.label: primer
items.definition: An oligonucleotide used to start the reaction in a polymerase-chain reaction.

items.label: spike in
items.definition: An RNA spike-in is an RNA transcript of known sequence and quantity used to calibrate measurements in RNA hybridization assays, such as DNA microarray experiments, RT-qPCR, and RNA-Seq.

items.label: barcode
items.definition: A barcode is a short known DNA sequence that is added during the library preparation in order to identify the origin of the read during data analysis. This enables for example the pooling and simultaneous sequencing of different samples ("multiplexing").

items.label: cDNA read
items.definition: The sequencing read that contains the cDNA read.

items.label: single cell identifier
items.definition: A unique identifier for a single cell specimen.

items.label: single cell library construction protocol
items.definition: A protocol describing the processes performed and equipment used to prepare a single cell nucleic acid sequencing library.

items.label: single cell isolation protocol
items.definition: A protocol describing the equipment and procedure by which a single cell suspension is separated into individual cells in order to allow individual cell barcoding.

items.label: spike in dilution
items.definition: Dilution factor of the RNA spike-in.
